scope: Supply and install an open, accessible internal cold-water route using VALTEC VTp.700.0020 PP-R PN25 pipe, diameter 20 mm, compatible socket-welded PP-R fittings and visible replaceable planning assumptions. Connected fixtures, valves, insulation, penetrations, fire stopping and concealed construction are separate technologies.

PDF pages 1-12: compatible VTp.700 polypropylene fittings; page 12 clauses 5.1-5.8 and the 20 mm fusion cycle; same-manufacturer fitting recommendation, hydraulic testing and flushing

selectedPreliminaryProfile.assumptionPolicy: The exact VALTEC pipe, 20 mm dimensions, mass, internal volume, section lengths, fusion cycle, test-pressure rule, flushing requirement and compatible socket-fusion system are bound to official documents. The total fusion balance includes two sockets per straight coupling and elbow, three per tee, and one per threaded transition or terminal cap; the same total drives welding-machine time, while straight and node labor remain separately visible without overlap. Reserve, support spacing/package, productivity, consumable capacities, test-section length, flushing cycles, substrate, height, working pressure and logistics are visible replaceable planning assumptions. Straight coupling, elbow, tee, threaded-transition and terminal-cap counts are project-route facts and are never inferred from length.

engineeringLimitations: The fusion balance is explicit: all fitting sockets are counted once, machine time uses the combined socket count, straight-fusion labor uses straight sockets, and node labor uses fitting items.

This profile is only a selected 20 mm open, accessible internal cold-water route. Hydraulic sizing, service class, temperature, pressure, fire classification, seismic bracing and project routing must be verified before purchase.
Support type and spacing must be replaced after the actual substrate, temperature, movement and project requirements are known; the visible 0.5 m assumption is not a universal manufacturer norm.
Straight couplings and route-node fittings are project geometry and stay visible until supplied. They are not derived from pipe length or manufactured row count.
Connected fixtures, valves, meters, insulation, penetrations, fire stopping, builders work and concealed finishes are excluded from this bounded route technology.
The KG rate source is not used to invent a universal labor or machine productivity; planning productivities remain visible and editable.
Manufacturer RUB list prices are not imported as KGS estimate prices. Unknown prices stay null and never become zero.
